subject.title: fix(telegram): Allow multi-agent ACP bindings within same account

question: For the same Telegram account and topic, should a different ACP session key create multiple active bindings or explicitly hand off the topic to the latest session?
rationale: The PR claims independent multi-agent bindings, but the current model has one record per account/topic, so true multi-binding changes routing and delivery semantics beyond a mechanical fix.

options.title: Treat Same-Account Rebind As Handoff
options.body: Keep one binding per account/topic, allow same-account replacement, and update the PR description, tests, and proof to match that behavior.

options.title: Design Multiple Active Bindings
options.body: Pause this branch until maintainers define how inbound routing, native commands, and completion delivery choose among multiple session keys for one topic.

options.title: Keep Current Binding Model
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if maintainers do not want same-account topic ownership changes in Telegram ACP bindings now.

recommendation.title: Treat Same-Account Rebind As Handoff
recommendation.body: Keep one binding per account/topic, allow same-account replacement, and update the PR description, tests, and proof to match that behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz merged the original persistent ACP binding feature and is the best routing candidate for the binding-model decision.
